response.justification: Bogdan has a strong technical background in developer tools, testing infrastructure, and CI/CD, making him an excellent fit for the technical domain of engineering productivity. However, this is a Level II Engineering Manager role requiring at least two years of formal people management. His resume shows a trajectory of a highly skilled individual contributor and technical leader (Staff Engineer), but lacks explicit evidence of managing direct reports, conducting one-on-ones, handling performance evaluations, or driving organizational change.
strengths: Strong technical background in engineering productivity, having built custom test runners, assertion libraries, and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience through organizing coding dojos, workshops, and courses.
Solid domain knowledge in mobile applications and varied tech stacks, including iOS and cross-device platforms.
concerns: Complete absence of documented people management experience, missing the minimum requirement of 2 years.
Lacks demonstrated experience in driving strategic organizational change as required for a mid-to-senior management role.
Career trajectory is strongly aligned with an Individual Contributor (IC) track rather than an Engineering Management track.
